title: Lifting Operation Permit (Enhanced)
description: Free Lifting Operation Permit (Enhanced) template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit information, lift details, lift plan & documentation.
standard: ASME B30 Series - LOLER - API RP 2D

Risk Assessment & Hazard Identification

Check all hazards applicable to this lifting operation:

CRITICAL HAZARDS: | EQUIPMENT-RELATED HAZARDS:

☐ Toppling / Tip-over / Overturn | ☐ Mechanical failure (crane)

☐ Dropped / Suspended load | ☐ Rigging failure (sling break)

☐ Load instability / shifting | ☐ Hydraulic failure

☐ Overloading (exceeding SWL) | ☐ Electrical fault

☐ Two-blocking | ☐ Outrigger failure / settlement

☐ Collision with structures/equipment | ☐ Boom failure / collapse

☐ Contact with overhead power lines | ☐ Wire rope failure

☐ Personnel struck by load/equipment | ☐ Hook failure / safety latch issue

☐ Person in swing radius / crush zone | ☐ Tyre/track failure

ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS: | SITE HAZARDS:

☐ High wind (>32 km/h) | ☐ Uneven/soft ground

☐ Lightning / electrical storm | ☐ Slopes / inclines

☐ Poor visibility (fog, dust, darkness) | ☐ Excavations / trenches nearby

☐ Extreme heat / cold | ☐ Confined area / restricted access

☐ Rain / ice / snow | ☐ Other equipment operating (SIMOPS)

☐ Dust / sand storms | ☐ Pedestrian traffic

HUMAN FACTORS: | LOAD-SPECIFIC HAZARDS:

☐ Incompetent / untrained personnel | ☐ Unstable / irregular load

☐ Communication failure | ☐ Fragile / delicate load

☐ Fatigue / long hours | ☐ Hazardous materials (chemicals, etc.)

☐ Hand-signal miscommunication | ☐ High center of gravity

☐ Distraction / inattention | ☐ Load with loose parts/components

☐ Unauthorized personnel in area | ☐ Lifting multiple items

OTHER HAZARDS (Specify): ______________
